ex-02-s3: WITH item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(subtotal_idr) AS item_subtotal_idr FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_checked, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.total_amount_idr <> it.item_subtotal_idr - COALESCE(o.discount_amount_idr, 0)) AS order_amount_mismatches, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.total_amount_idr <> it.item_subtotal_idr - COALESCE(o.discount_amount_idr, 0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS mismatch_rate_pct FROM orders o JOIN item_totals it ON it.order_id = o.order_id;

ex-04-s1: WITH monthly_orders AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr, AVG(o.total_amount_idr) AS aov_idr FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY 1), monthly_units AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS month, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY 1), combined AS (SELECT mo.*, mu.units_sold FROM monthly_orders mo JOIN monthly_units mu USING (month)) SELECT month, orders, revenue_idr, units_sold, ROUND(aov_idr, 2) AS aov_idr, LAG(revenue_idr) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue_idr, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue_idr - LAG(revenue_idr) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue_idr) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS revenue_mom_pct, ROUND(100.0 * (orders - LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS orders_mom_pct FROM combined ORDER BY month;

ex-06-s1: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS product_revenue_idr, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id), ranked AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand, ps.units_sold, ps.product_revenue_idr, ps.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.units_sold DESC) AS unit_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.product_revenue_idr DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM product_sales ps JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ps.product_id) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE unit_rank <= 10 OR revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY revenue_rank, unit_rank, product_id;
ex-07-s1: WITH product_clean AS (SELECT product_id, brand, sub_category, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'dress' THEN 'Dress' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) IN ('jacket', 'jaket') THEN 'Jaket' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kaos' THEN 'Kaos' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kemeja' THEN 'Kemeja' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 't-shirt' THEN 'T-Shirt' ELSE TRIM(category) END AS category_normalized FROM products), sales AS (SELECT pc.category_normalized, pc.sub_category, pc.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS revenue_idr, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN product_clean pc ON pc.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY pc.category_normalized, pc.sub_category, pc.brand) SELECT * FROM sales ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC;
ex-07-s2: WITH product_clean AS (SELECT product_id, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'dress' THEN 'Dress' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) IN ('jacket', 'jaket') THEN 'Jaket' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kaos' THEN 'Kaos' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kemeja' THEN 'Kemeja' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 't-shirt' THEN 'T-Shirt' ELSE TRIM(category) END AS category_normalized FROM products), category_sales AS (SELECT pc.category_normalized, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS revenue_idr FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN product_clean pc ON pc.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY pc.category_normalized) SELECT category_normalized, units_sold, revenue_idr, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC) AS revenue_rank, ROUND(100.0 * revenue_idr / SUM(revenue_idr) OVER (), 2) AS revenue_contribution_pct FROM category_sales ORDER BY revenue_rank;
ex-08-s1: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id), scored AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand, p.stock, COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) AS units_sold, CASE WHEN p.stock = 0 AND COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) > 0 THEN 'Out of stock + sold' WHEN p.stock <= 20 AND COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) > 0 THEN 'Low stock + sold' WHEN p.stock >= 150 AND COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) <= 5 THEN 'High stock + low/no sales' WHEN COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) = 0 THEN 'No recorded valid sales' ELSE 'Other' END AS opportunity_flag FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_sales ps ON ps.product_id = p.product_id) SELECT * FROM scored WHERE opportunity_flag <> 'Other' ORDER BY CASE opportunity_flag WHEN 'Out of stock + sold' THEN 1 WHEN 'Low stock + sold' THEN 2 WHEN 'High stock + low/no sales' THEN 3 WHEN 'No recorded valid sales' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, units_sold DESC, stock DESC;
ex-09-s1: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS revenue_idr FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id) SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.price_idr AS current_price_idr, p.avg_rating, COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) AS units_sold, COALESCE(ps.revenue_idr, 0) AS revenue_idr, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) >= 20 AND p.avg_rating >= 4.5 THEN 'High sales + high rating' WHEN COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) >= 20 AND p.avg_rating < 4.0 THEN 'High sales + lower rating' WHEN COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) <= 5 AND p.avg_rating >= 4.5 THEN 'Low sales + high rating' ELSE 'Other' END AS product_signal FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_sales ps ON ps.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY units_sold DESC, avg_rating DESC;
ex-09-s2: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id) SELECT CASE WHEN p.price_idr < 250000 THEN '<250K' WHEN p.price_idr < 500000 THEN '250K-<500K' WHEN p.price_idr < 750000 THEN '500K-<750K' ELSE '>=750K' END AS price_band, COUNT(*) AS products, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0)), 2) AS avg_units_sold_per_product, SUM(COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0)) AS total_units_sold FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_sales ps ON ps.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(p.price_idr);
ex-10-s1: WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.gender, c.age_group, c.city, c.province, COUNT(o.order_id) AS valid_order_count, SUM(o.total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_valid_order_date, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_valid_order_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.gender, c.age_group, c.city, c.province) SELECT COUNT(*) AS buying_customers, ROUND(AVG(valid_order_count), 2) AS avg_orders_per_buying_customer, ROUND(AVG(revenue_idr), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_buying_customer, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_order_count = 1) AS one_time_buyers, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_order_count > 1) AS repeat_buyers, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_order_count > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_buyer_rate_pct FROM customer_sales;
ex-10-s2: WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY o.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC) AS revenue_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS order_rank FROM customer_sales) SELECT customer_id, order_count, revenue_idr, revenue_rank, order_rank, revenue_rank + order_rank AS combined_rank_score FROM ranked ORDER BY combined_rank_score, customer_id LIMIT 25;
ex-11-s1: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), customer_metrics AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(*) AS frequency, SUM(total_amount_idr) AS monetary FROM valid_orders GROUP BY customer_id), reference_date AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date FROM valid_orders), scored AS (SELECT cm.*, (rd.max_order_date - cm.last_order_date) AS recency_days, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY cm.last_order_date DESC) AS r_score, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY cm.frequency) AS f_score, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY cm.monetary) AS m_score FROM customer_metrics cm CROSS JOIN reference_date rd) SELECT customer_id, recency_days, frequency, monetary AS revenue_idr, r_score, f_score, m_score, CASE WHEN r_score >= 3 AND f_score >= 3 AND m_score >= 3 THEN 'High-value active' WHEN f_score >= 3 AND m_score >= 3 THEN 'Frequent high-value' WHEN r_score >= 3 THEN 'Recent buyers' WHEN r_score = 1 AND f_score <= 2 AND m_score <= 2 THEN 'Lapsed low-value' ELSE 'Mid-tier' END AS segment FROM scored ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC;
ex-12-s1: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), first_purchase AS (SELECT customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(order_date))::DATE AS cohort_month FROM valid_orders GROUP BY customer_id), customer_months AS (SELECT DISTINCT vo.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', vo.order_date)::DATE AS purchase_month FROM valid_orders vo), cohort_activity AS (SELECT fp.cohort_month, cm.purchase_month, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM first_purchase fp JOIN customer_months cm ON cm.customer_id = fp.customer_id GROUP BY fp.cohort_month, cm.purchase_month), cohort_sizes AS (SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_customers FROM first_purchase GROUP BY cohort_month) SELECT ca.cohort_month, ca.purchase_month, ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.purchase_month) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.cohort_month)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ca.purchase_month) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ca.cohort_month))::INT AS month_number, cs.cohort_customers, ca.active_customers, ROUND(100.0 * ca.active_customers / NULLIF(cs.cohort_customers, 0), 2) AS retention_rate_pct FROM cohort_activity ca JOIN cohort_sizes cs USING (cohort_month) ORDER BY ca.cohort_month, month_number;
ex-13-s1: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), promo_summary AS (SELECT COALESCE(promo_code, 'NO_PROMO') AS promo_code, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr, AVG(total_amount_idr) AS aov_idr, SUM(COALESCE(discount_amount_idr, 0)) AS discount_idr FROM valid_orders GROUP BY COALESCE(promo_code, 'NO_PROMO')) SELECT promo_code, orders, revenue_idr, ROUND(aov_idr, 2) AS aov_idr, discount_idr, ROUND(100.0 * orders / SUM(orders) OVER (), 2) AS order_share_pct FROM promo_summary ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC;

ex-15-s1: SELECT courier, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned') AS returned_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'cancelled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(shipping_cost_idr), 2) AS avg_shipping_cost_idr FROM orders GROUP BY courier ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC, orders DESC;

ex-17-s1: WITH sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS revenue_idr FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id), review_stats AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS avg_review_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id), product_metrics AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, COALESCE(s.units_sold, 0) AS units_sold, COALESCE(s.revenue_idr, 0) AS revenue_idr, rs.review_count, rs.avg_review_rating FROM products p LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN review_stats rs ON rs.product_id = p.product_id) SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units_sold DESC) AS sales_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_review_rating DESC NULLS LAST) AS rating_rank, CASE WHEN avg_review_rating >= 4.5 AND units_sold <= 5 THEN 'High rating + low sales' WHEN avg_review_rating < 3.5 AND units_sold >= 20 THEN 'Lower rating + high sales' ELSE 'Other' END AS experience_signal FROM product_metrics WHERE review_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN experience_signal <> 'Other' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, avg_review_rating DESC NULLS LAST, units_sold DESC;
ex-18-s1: WITH valid_order_products AS (SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, oi.product_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), pairs AS (SELECT a.product_id AS product_a, b.product_id AS product_b, COUNT(*) AS order_pair_count FROM valid_order_products a JOIN valid_order_products b ON a.order_id = b.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id) SELECT p1.name AS product_a, p2.name AS product_b, pairs.order_pair_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pairs.order_pair_count DESC) AS pair_rank FROM pairs JOIN products p1 ON p1.product_id = pairs.product_a JOIN products p2 ON p2.product_id = pairs.product_b ORDER BY pair_rank, product_a, product_b LIMIT 30;
ex-19-s1: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) AS customer_order_count, SUM(o.total_amount_idr) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) AS customer_revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), customer_segment AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, CASE WHEN customer_order_count >= 5 AND customer_revenue >= 5000000 THEN 'High-value repeat' WHEN customer_order_count >= 2 THEN 'Repeat' ELSE 'One-time' END AS customer_segment FROM customer_orders), product_clean AS (SELECT product_id, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'dress' THEN 'Dress' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) IN ('jacket', 'jaket') THEN 'Jaket' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kaos' THEN 'Kaos' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kemeja' THEN 'Kemeja' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 't-shirt' THEN 'T-Shirt' ELSE TRIM(category) END AS category_normalized FROM products) SELECT cs.customer_segment, pc.category_normalized, COUNT(DISTINCT co.customer_id) AS customers, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS item_revenue_idr, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.customer_segment ORDER BY SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) DESC) AS category_rank_within_segment FROM customer_orders co JOIN customer_segment cs ON cs.customer_id = co.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id JOIN product_clean pc ON pc.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY cs.customer_segment, pc.category_normalized ORDER BY cs.customer_segment, category_rank_within_segment;
ex-20-s1: WITH sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id) SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.brand, p.stock, COALESCE(s.units_sold, 0) AS units_sold, 'RESTOCK_REVIEW' AS action_signal FROM products p LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE COALESCE(s.units_sold, 0) > 0 AND p.stock <= 20 ORDER BY units_sold DESC, stock ASC;
